faq.q: What's the difference between JPG and PNG image formats?
faq.a: JPG uses lossy compression and doesn't support transparency, making it ideal for photographs. PNG uses lossless compression and supports transparent backgrounds, making it perfect for graphics, logos, and images requiring transparency. Our JPG to PNG converter helps you switch between these formats.

faq.q: Will converting JPG to PNG improve my image quality?
faq.a: Converting JPG to PNG won't improve the original quality since JPG compression has already been applied, but it prevents further quality loss and adds transparency support. PNG preserves the current quality without additional compression during our conversion process.

faq.q: Can I convert multiple JPG files to PNG simultaneously?
faq.a: Yes, our JPG to PNG converter supports batch processing. You can upload multiple JPG files simultaneously and convert them all to PNG format in one operation, saving time and effort for bulk conversions.

faq.q: Does the converted PNG file support transparency?
faq.a: Yes, all converted PNG files support full transparency capabilities. While the original JPG won't have transparent areas, you can use additional editing tools to remove backgrounds or add transparent areas to your converted PNG images.

faq.q: Are there file size limits for JPG to PNG conversion?
faq.a: Our JPG to PNG converter handles various file sizes efficiently. For optimal performance, we recommend files under 50MB per image, though larger files are supported with extended processing time.

faq.q: When should I use PNG instead of JPG format?
faq.a: Use PNG when you need transparency, lossless quality, or are working with graphics, logos, screenshots, or images with text. Use JPG for photographs where file size is more important than perfect quality. Our converter helps you switch formats as needed.
